title: PPML and Heavy-Tailed Trade and Factor Flows: Why Standard Inference Fails and How to Fix It
abstract: arXiv:2609.18750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) estimator is widely used for estimating bilateral gravity equations. Its consistency requires only a correctly specified conditional mean. Conventional inference, however, also requires finite-variance scores and Gaussian limits. We show that these conditions fail: bilateral flows are Pareto-tailed, PPML scores have a stable limit under a structural gravity data-generating process, and sandwich confidence intervals are too narrow. We retain PPML for point estimation but replace sandwich inference with an m-out-of-n bootstrap robust to heavy tails. Across three bilateral data settings, the correction is large and overturns conventionally significant gravity coefficients.

translated_title: PPML与厚尾贸易和要素流动：标准推断为何失效以及如何修正
translated_abstract: 泊松伪极大似然（PPML）估计量被广泛用于估计双边引力方程。其一致性只需条件均值被正确设定。然而，传统推断还要求得分具有有限方差和高斯极限。我们证明这些条件并不成立：双边流量呈帕累托厚尾分布，PPML得分在结构引力数据生成过程下具有稳定极限，而三明治置信区间则过于狭窄。我们在点估计中保留PPML，但用对厚尾稳健的m-out-of-n自助法取代三明治推断。在三个双边数据设定中，该修正幅度很大，并推翻了传统上显著的引力系数。
tldr: 该论文证明当双边贸易和要素流量呈帕累托厚尾分布时，PPML传统的三明治置信区间会过窄而导致标准推断失效，并提出用对厚尾稳健的m-out-of-n自助法取代三明治推断，修正结果幅度很大并推翻了传统显著的引力系数。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that standard PPML inference fails when bilateral trade and factor flows are Pareto-tailed, as sandwich confidence intervals become too narrow, and proposes replacing sandwich inference with an m-out-of-n bootstrap robust to heavy tails, yielding large corrections that overturn conventionally significant gravity coefficients.
